ai.scope: Codex assisted member B in creating the Node backend foundation, PostgreSQL migration scripts, health/readiness endpoints, middle-platform identity adapter boundary, audit redaction, and automated tests.
ai.disposition: Adopted after B inspected the implementation and ran local quality checks; member A must independently review before PR merge.

scope.evidence: Changes are limited to G4-02 backend, migration, configuration, tests, and self-check assets.

contract.evidence: Frozen OpenAPI is linted without being rewritten; G4-02 adds only internal health and identity skeleton behavior.

authorizationAndValidation.evidence: The minimal protected endpoint rejects absent or insufficient identity context and records the result.

parameterizedAccess.evidence: Audit persistence uses PostgreSQL positional parameters; no dynamic SQL is constructed from request input.

secrets.evidence: Configuration uses environment references only; example files contain no credentials and the secret scan covers backend paths.

logRedaction.evidence: Audit redaction removes token, credential, password and secret values before logging or persistence.

migrationRollback.evidence: 001_foundation has reviewed up/down SQL scripts and a transactional migration runner; Docker/PostgreSQL is unavailable on this workstation, so a real forward/rollback execution is explicitly deferred to the PR review environment.

tests.evidence: Backend tests exercise configuration, audit redaction, health/readiness, authorization and audit outcomes.

traceability.evidence: The self-check maps G4-02 to KN-043/045, NFR-MNT-01, G4-02-DoD and ENG-012/014/015/017.
